text: {"lessons":["My account rose overall but still fell 4.4% in the latest month, reminding me that short-term losses can happen even when I make no trades.","I should review whether my holdings and cash are balanced enough to support my living expenses and limit large swings, rather than assuming that holding steady alone manages risk.","I will avoid reacting to one month's move and trade only when I have a clear reason that fits my need for stability."]}
